title: Allocate, 2026-10-27: the groups starve while 120 of their items wait

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Findings
sections.content:
Measured 2026-10-27 with clerk flow --open over every governed repo, after both groups were unpaused (reports received in the 08:36 session, srs-programme#295).

- The two groups hold 120 open items (WG Third-party ready 89, WG Agent-supported editor 31). 20 pass every flow dot; about 6 carry ready. Each group has a budget of 10 per cycle.
- Topup keeps ONE programme-wide Ready queue at a target of 6 (default; the board-sync workflow cannot set it). Ready stood at 10, so topup nominated nothing and the 20 flowing items stayed in Backlog. A dry run at target 30 nominated only clerk and srs-programme P1 items: topup fills by epic priority, so a P2 group epic (semanticops.com#31) is always fed last.
- 63 items are held, mostly parked. All 48 parked labels were set in one sweep on 2026-10-08; 42 carry no stated reason. Where a reason was given ("until its work is ranked"), the epic has since been ranked, but nothing lifts the label.
- 86 items have no technical plan. Only WG Third-party ready has an analyst (clerk#124 item 3).
- 50 items reach no ranked epic: 30 have no parent reaching a roadmap epic; 20 sit under the parked muDemocracy.org epics #94, #293 and #83.
- 24 needs-input issues: 6 were not questions (a wait or agent work), 15 were answerable from principles and rulings, 3 were real questions.
- The SRS Bug Fixer cloud routine is disabled and still carries the old standalone prompt, so no bug is fixed anywhere; its clerk brief (routines/bug-fixer.md step 2) skips a group bug unless the group is unpaused with room, so a bug stops with the group and spends its budget.

This is the shadow of the pole Hold until ready (9617fbda): "Hundreds of parked issues and an empty queue."
